description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer (AI-Focused)

Contract type: Full-time

Salary: Starting from €40,000 per annum gross, subject to location, skills and experience


Not Your Typical Workplace:

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we are building at WorkMotion.Our remote-first team spans across the world, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role.…

Our Engineering Team is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer (AI-Focused). In this role, you’ll drive the test automation strategy, design robust test suites, and ensure the quality and reliability of our products across multiple services and platforms.


Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

Core QA Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test cases for web, API, and backend services
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, ensure comprehensive test coverage and high-quality releases
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and monitor test execution results.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor junior QA engineers, and promote best practices for test automation
  • Investigate and report bugs and issues with detailed reproduction steps and logs
  • Ensure test data, environments, and tools are properly maintained and aligned with team needs
  • Proactively contribute to our quality culture and participate in improving testing processes


AI & Modern QA Responsibilities

  • Utilize AI-powered development and testing tools to accelerate QA processes
  • Apply AI-assisted test generation, debugging, and defect analysis techniques
  • Evaluate and implement AI-driven QA solutions for automation optimization
  • Use tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar AI platforms effectively in daily workflows
  • Collaborate with engineering teams on AI-assisted SDLC initiatives

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…
  • 6+ years of professional experience in QA automation
  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks like Cypress or Playwright
  • Solid experience testing RESTful APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or Insomnia
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
  • Deep understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and QA methodologies
  • Knowledge of version control tools like Git
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Desirable (but not required):

  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS
  • ISTQB or other relevant certifications
  • Experience in contract testing or TDD/BDD
Our Engineering Culture…
  • Ownership over hand-offs Teams own outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Quality with speed We move quickly without treating engineering quality as optional.
  • Pragmatism over perfection We make deliberate trade-offs based on business and technical context.
  • Transparency Risks, mistakes, and disagreements should surface early. 
  • Continuous improvement Our architecture, processes, and ways of working should get better as we scale.
  • Collaboration Great products come from Engineering, Product, Design, Security, Data, and business teams working together.

The Perks of Being Here…
  • Global, remote, and thriving:  We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. 
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. 

*Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. 

At WorkMotion, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on . We’re here to support you every step of the way!
